media_item.focus_or_theme: Collection of stories of exonerated individuals, death row experiences, wrongful convictions
media_item.summary_notes: This play is particularly significant in the study of wrongful convictions as it uses the actual words of exonerees to tell their stories, creating a powerful first-person narrative of the experience of being wrongfully convicted and sentenced to death. The play combines first-person monologues with scenes set in courtrooms and prisons, creating a comprehensive picture of the American criminal justice system's failures. The play has had significant cultural and political impact, including a special performance for Illinois Governor George Ryan in December 2002, shortly before he commuted all death sentences in Illinois to life imprisonment due to concerns about wrongful convictions. The original Off-Broadway production featured notable actors including Richard Dreyfuss, Jill Clayburgh, and Jay O. Sanders, and ran for over 600 performances.
media_item.case_details_raw: The play features six individuals who collectively spent over 100 years on death row for crimes they did not commit.  Their stories are told using their own words from interviews, letters, transcripts, case files, and public records. The play combines first-person monologues with courtroom and prison scenes.

research_notes_raw:
This play is particularly significant in the study of wrongful convictions as it uses the actual words of exonerees to tell their stories, creating a powerful first-person narrative of the experience of being wrongfully convicted and sentenced to death. The play combines first-person monologues with scenes set in courtrooms and prisons, creating a comprehensive picture of the American criminal justice system's failures.

The play has had significant cultural and political impact, including a special performance for Illinois Governor George Ryan in December 2002, shortly before he commuted all death sentences in Illinois to life imprisonment due to concerns about wrongful convictions.

The original Off-Broadway production featured notable actors including Richard Dreyfuss, Jill Clayburgh, and Jay O. Sanders, and ran for over 600 performances. It won numerous awards including the Lucille Lortel Award for Unique Theatrical Experience, the Drama Desk Award for Unique Theatrical Experience, and the Outer Critics Circle Award for Outstanding Off-Broadway Play.
